measurementProtocol.resetTiming: Once immediately before each style's appearance change and nine-page navigation/capture workload
measurementProtocol.fixtureData: Isolated synthetic local repositories; public provider unconfigured
measurementProtocol.framePercentiles: Android gfxinfo histogram percentiles as reported, in milliseconds
measurementProtocol.jankDefinition: Android gfxinfo's current and legacy classifications are preserved separately
measurementProtocol.comparison: No controlled workload synchronization, baseline or causal comparison between themes
measurementProtocol.laterSettingsRepair: Nine Settings PNG/JSON captures were repaired after the original nine-page workloads; those later context captures did not reset or overwrite the gfxinfo files. They are marked separately per observation.

collection.timingLimitation: Runner died after terminal instrumentation success before metadata publication; log filesystem modification time is retained, exact command start/wall time unavailable.

sourceAudit.scope: Read-only inspection of Liquid drawing/motion and platform signal sources; not a profiler or Apple runtime result
constraints: Three-stop static card/page linear gradients; no full-screen blur, RenderEffect, shader, backdrop capture or infinite decorative animation APIs in reviewed theme source.
Liquid surface opacity is bounded 70–100% over a local opaque theme backdrop; maximum shadow 6dp.
Full Liquid Material controls use finite spring specifications; other motion uses finite tweens. Dashboard goal progress uses finite tween.

OS reduce motion or low power resolves motion to 0ms. Low power, high contrast and reduced effects disable gradients/elevation and force opaque surfaces; reduced transparency also removes gradients and forces opacity 1.
Existing foreground map countdown and foreground 30-second sync are semantic lifecycle work. Appearance does not add provider polling.
The Today mini-chart uses at most 12 selected observations; Studio has four static theme previews.

limitations: SwiftShader emulator observations do not establish physical Android GPU, battery, CPU, RAM or power behavior.
Automated scrolling, theme changes, app navigation, screenshot readback and test waits affect these counters; they are not steady-state idle or gameplay measurements.
No FPS, battery life, energy use, sound-to-photon or input-to-photon latency is inferred.
No cross-style performance ranking, optimization claim or causal comparison is supported by these unsynchronized runs.
GPU histogram values including the 4950ms bucket are retained exactly as Android reports them on the software emulator; they are not interpreted as physical GPU latency.
gfxinfo counters need not represent disjoint or unique frames; current and legacy jank use different classifications.
No physical-device benchmark, release acceptance threshold or Apple/iOS performance execution was performed.
The interrupted large-text runner has a recovered log modification timestamp but no exact command start or wall time. Null timing fields and its recorded uncertainty are preserved.
Source audit hashes identify current reviewed code; the observation runs span test-harness selector/capture repairs and are not synchronized benchmark workloads.

Final source review includes later allowlisted widget navigation, test additions and visibility/dialog harness fixes. Raw navigation observations predate those changes; no native widget performance claim is derived from app gfxinfo.
